accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Quality Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, Database Engineering, Reliability Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering are active with distinct ownership boundaries.

Infrastructure Engineering owns declarative infrastructure lifecycle semantics: configuration/state/live-resource reconciliation, plan/apply review, drift, imports/moves/refactors, module/provider lifecycle, destructive-change review, state/backend safety, and infrastructure recovery reasoning.

Infrastructure Engineering does not absorb application implementation, application artifact promotion, live-service reliability, Cloudflare/provider product architecture, database-engine semantics, security authority/policy, or independent QA.
Desired configuration, IaC state, and live provider reality are separate evidence views. A speculative plan is not an applied change; apply success is not proof of user-visible service health.
Drift must be classified before reconciliation; supported import/move/refactor mechanisms are preferred over direct state surgery; direct state mutation is elevated recovery work.
Terraform, OpenTofu, Packer, cloud CLIs, provider APIs and MCP/tools are execution/reference surfaces and do not create mutation authority.
Provider/tool/version/backend-specific behavior remains live-doc-sensitive when material.

The proactive capability-expansion wave that began with ecosystem capability-gap scanning is now closed. Immediate high-value candidates have either been promoted, mapped to reference packs, or rejected as standalone faculties.

Mobile Flutter/Android remains a progressive reference pack; observability tooling is owned by Reliability Engineering; Postgres practices are owned by Database Engineering; Terraform/OpenTofu/Packer knowledge is owned progressively by Infrastructure Engineering; browser/computer control remains an execution surface.
Healthcare/clinical informatics remains a later/high-bar bounded area rather than an immediate generic medical skill because of its high-stakes evidence requirements.
Further skill expansion should restart only when representative ordinary work exposes a concrete uncovered capability gap or a current faculty materially underperforms.
unresolved_risks: Infrastructure Engineering promotion is architecture- and contract-supported, but measurable DEDAL-specific outcome gains still require representative ordinary infrastructure work.
Infrastructure tooling/provider behavior changes quickly; live official documentation remains necessary for material syntax, backend, provider, compatibility and migration details.
State and partial-apply recovery can be destructive; task-scoped authority and explicit recovery semantics remain mandatory.
Small single-host workflows can be over-engineered if Infrastructure Engineering is invoked for trivial shell configuration; smallest-sufficient composition remains mandatory.
Healthcare/clinical informatics may later justify bounded specialist capabilities, but generic clinical-skill promotion remains intentionally deferred.

next_executable_step.action: Pause proactive skill expansion. Apply the current Cognitive Runtime and 24 active faculties naturally during ordinary Creator work. Record genuine routing wins, missed support, context waste, ownership collisions, regressions, or uncovered capability gaps. Reopen Skill Acquisition only when such evidence or an explicit Creator request justifies it.
